data.name: Dharma
data.gender_notes: Dharma is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root dhṛ, 'to hold, support' — dharma, 'that which upholds'. Its root is Sanskrit dhṛ (धृ). A central concept in Hindu philosophy. Dharma is a Sanskrit name meaning “Righteousness; duty; law”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dharma expresses “Righteousness; duty; law”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root dhṛ, 'to hold, support' — dharma, 'that which upholds'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dharma total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
